Interface + extraction checklist: `harness/README.md`.

Recorded in `evals/_structure/`: EDB-14 → Resolved, EDB-19 annotated (its remaining wiring == this issue), CHARTER decision 8 corrected in place (the reused meta-harness is in-repo, not a separate repo). This M5 build now routes its with-skill / without / baseline rollouts through `harness/` on cheap/free models per decisions 6–8.
